items.title: George Shearing interviewed by Joe Williams, New York City, New York, March 8, 1996
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...you’d get Ray McKinley in one place and you’d get Ellington in one place... INTERVIEWEE: Yes. That’s the way it was.

ctx.x: Remember the time I mean you’d go to the hotels in the City of New York, you’d get Ray McKinley in one place and you’d get Ellington in one place, and you’d get, you know.
Yes. That’s the way it was.
